verdict.rationale: Weaviate lets users get AI-generated answers from their data. It does this through natural-language prompts in the quickstart (marked Cloud only), RAG/generative queries in a single query interface, and a Query Agent for agentic search over Weaviate Cloud collections. This covers question-answering over data rather than proactive insights or suggestions, and the agentic pieces are restricted to Cloud. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced in the product, availability outside Weaviate Cloud for the Query Agent and natural-language answers, in-depth docs on insight generation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
